5.web: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
5.asv: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

6.web: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Diphath, and Togarmah.
6.asv: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Diphath, and Togarmah.

7.web: The sons of Javan: Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.
7.asv: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

8.web: The sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
8.asv: The sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

9.web: The sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raama, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba, and Dedan.
9.asv: And the sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raama, and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba, and Dedan.

10.web: Cush became the father of Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
10.asv: And Cush begat Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

11.web: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
11.asv: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

12.web: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.
12.asv: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim (from whence came the Philistines), and Caphtorim.

13.web: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,
13.asv: And Canaan begat Sidon his first-born, and Heth,

14.web: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
14.asv: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

15.web: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
15.asv: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

16.web: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
16.asv: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

17.web: The sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arpachshad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
17.asv: The sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arpachshad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.

18.web: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.
18.asv: And Arpachshad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

19.web: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
19.asv: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.

20.web: Joktan became the father of Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
20.asv: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

21.web: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
21.asv: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

22.web: and Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
22.asv: and Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

23.web: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
23.asv: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

28.web: The sons of Abraham: Isaac, and Ishmael.
28.asv: The sons of Abraham: Isaac, and Ishmael.

29.web: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
29.asv: These are their generations: the first-born of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

30.web: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
30.asv: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

31.web: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
31.asv: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

32.web: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba, and Dedan.
32.asv: And the sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba, and Dedan.

33.web: The sons of Midian: Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
33.asv: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

34.web: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau, and Israel.
34.asv: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau, and Israel.

35.web: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah.
35.asv: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah.

36.web: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
36.asv: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.

37.web: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
37.asv: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

38.web: The sons of Seir: Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.
38.asv: And the sons of Seir: Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.

39.web: The sons of Lotan: Hori, and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
39.asv: And the sons of Lotan: Hori, and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.

40.web: The sons of Shobal: Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah, and Anah.
40.asv: The sons of Shobal: Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah, and Anah.

41.web: The sons of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
41.asv: The sons of Anah: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hamran, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

42.web: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, and Zaavan, Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz, and Aran.
42.asv: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, and Zaavan, Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz, and Aran.

43.web: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
43.asv: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

44.web: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
44.asv: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

45.web: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
45.asv: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.

46.web: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
46.asv: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Avith.

47.web: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
47.asv: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

48.web: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.
48.asv: And Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his stead.

49.web: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
49.asv: And Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

50.web: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai: and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
50.asv: And Baal-hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Pai: and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.

51.web: Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
51.asv: And Hadad died. And the chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

52.web: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
52.asv: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

53.web: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
53.asv: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

54.web: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
54.asv: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
